method_limits: definition counts are per file that contains a top-level def of the name; a file defining the same name twice counts once, and a name that only ever exists as a method counts zero -- so 'one_definition' means 'at most one module defines it', not 'the name is unique in the tree'

the second axis reads the caller's live source at the row's own line: a file that has changed since the row was indexed reports not_found_at_that_line and is classed unseen rather than assumed either way
an attribute call is classed as a method call on the strength of its spelling only; the receiver's type is not inferred, so a module object reached through an alias reads as attribute_qualified
the population is E439's wrapper set re-confirmed live; a wrapper whose call rows were dropped for any other reason is outside this face
residue is a floor: a bare call to a single-definition name may still be a local function that shadows nothing, and this scan cannot see local scope

distance_check.reading: the same rows, re-read on two axes instead of called overstated

title: grade every call row E439 dropped by reachability on two read axes -- how many modules define the name, and whether the call is attribute-qualified at its own line -- and publish the residue neither axis explains
